title: Radiator cover with fluted columns

options.name: The design
options.text: A radiator cover with an oak top, a white fluted column at each end and two doors in the middle with a mesh panel, so the heat still comes through. Both doors open outwards to reach the radiator and its valves. Press Open the doors to see inside.

poster.alt: 3D model of a white radiator cover with an oak top, fluted columns at each end and two mesh doors

sizes.label: Height, to the top of the oak
Doors
sizes.value: two, 698 mm each, with a mesh panel

sizes.label: Fluted columns
sizes.value: three flutes, stopping 85 mm from the top and bottom

notes: The width, height and depth and the door widths come from the drawing.
The column width, the flute size, the door frames and the thickness of the oak top are standard sizes to start from and will be checked on site.
The radiator is only there to show where it sits.
Colours on screen are a guide.
